scientific_findings: Old-lineage Fine+RG has larger W96 raw-G error than replay and initial for all three lineages at K256; descriptive only.
At K64, RG-minus-replay changes sign across lineages. Do not infer a sampling-independent gain.
Exact conditional quality, joint block quality, direct coarse generation and fine generation remain distinct endpoints.
Fresh F/P/D/M is scientifically useful to separate initialization history, coordinate changes and collective coarse variables.
precision: 32 generated fields per cell is development screening only.
Historical MC is independent of the training MC, but is not new confirmation data.
A3-N n32 MC-vs-MC 95th-percentile relative-G errors are about 0.20; cannot establish a 0.03 effect.
report_status_at_gate: All raw numerical evidence reviewed; local CPU figure rendering continues in parallel with B.
